subject: eng
title: Grammar 3A–3B Overview: Simple Past Tense, Connectives & Quantifiers

questions.q: We ___ a magic show at the children's centre yesterday.
questions.explain: 句末有過去時間詞 yesterday，動詞要用簡單過去式 watched。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: We ___ a magic show at the children's centre yesterday.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 3A–3B Overview: Simple Past Tense, Connectives & Quantifiers

questions.q: ___ you go to the library last Saturday? Yes, I did.
questions.explain: last Saturday 表示過去時間，一般過去時疑問句用助動詞 Did。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: ___ you go to the library last Saturday? Yes, I did.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 3A–3B Overview: Simple Past Tense, Connectives & Quantifiers

questions.q: Leo was hungry, ___ he ate a big sandwich.
questions.explain: 前半句是原因（肚餓），後半句是結果（吃三文治），用連接詞 so（所以）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Leo was hungry, ___ he ate a big sandwich.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 3A–3B Overview: Simple Past Tense, Connectives & Quantifiers

questions.q: Are there ___ bananas in the basket? No, there aren't any.
questions.explain: 在疑問句和否定句中，表示「一些／任何」通常用 any。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Are there ___ bananas in the basket? No, there aren't any.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 3A–3B Overview: Simple Past Tense, Connectives & Quantifiers

questions.q: ___ is this backpack? It is eighty-five dollars.
questions.explain: 詢問價錢（Prices: eighty-five dollars）用疑問詞 How much。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: ___ is this backpack? It is eighty-five dollars.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 3A–3B Overview: Simple Past Tense, Connectives & Quantifiers

questions.q: Fill in the past tense verb: Mum ___ (buy) some strawberries at the market yesterday.
questions.explain: buy 的不規則過去式是 bought。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Fill in the past tense verb: Mum ___ (buy) some strawberries at the market yesterday.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 3A–3B Overview: Simple Past Tense, Connectives & Quantifiers

questions.q: Rearrange the words to form a past tense question.
questions.explain: 過去式特殊疑問句：Where did you go last Sunday?
